title: Talent Insight Designer & Technical Lead
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Talent Insight Designer \& Technical Lead is a mid\-tier hands\-on role responsible for designing, building, and enhancing operational data products within Tier 1 HR applications and the broader HR technology stack.
   

  

 This role develops dashboards, reports, embedded analytics, insight artefacts, and operational reporting products that help Talent, People \& Culture, managers, and business leaders make informed decisions.
   

  

 The role requires strong knowledge of HR technology analytics capabilities, particularly SAP SuccessFactors Stories, SAP People Intelligence, Phenom People, Skillsoft, and other HR technology platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, test, and maintain operational data products within Tier 1 HR applications and related HR technologies.
* Develop dashboards, reports, embedded analytics, visualisations, insight packs, and self\-service reporting products.
* Build insight solutions across talent acquisition, talent growth, learning, skills, workforce planning, internal mobility, performance, succession, and retention.
* Translate approved requirements, KPI definitions, business rules, and user stories into accurate analytics outputs.
* Use SAP SuccessFactors Stories, SAP People Intelligence, Phenom People, Skillsoft, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other HR technologies to deliver operational insights.
* Partner with the Talent Analytics \& Insights Business Partner, product owners, system owners, and business stakeholders to understand how insights will be used.
* Work with IT Data COE, data engineering, and platform teams to understand datasets, data models, integrations, and technical constraints.
* Support metric logic, semantic layer design, dashboard structure, reporting standards, filters, and access requirements.
* Validate data outputs, reconcile metrics, identify data inconsistencies, and support resolution of data quality issues.
* Create visualisations and dashboards that tell a clear story and make complex talent data easier to interpret.
* Apply data visualisation, user experience, and storytelling principles to improve usability and adoption.
* Develop prototypes, mock\-ups, and proof\-of\-concept dashboards to test new insight ideas.
* Document report logic, data sources, metric definitions, assumptions, filters, access rules, and known limitations.
* Support user acceptance testing, dashboard demonstrations, release readiness, and business sign\-off.
* Educate business users on how to use dashboards, interpret insights, and apply new analytics methods.
* Monitor usage, feedback, and performance of analytics products to identify improvements.
* Ensure analytics products comply with data privacy, access control, security, and responsible employee data use requirements.


 Knowledge and Attributes
   

  

* Strong understanding of dashboard design, embedded analytics, operational reporting, insight storytelling, and HR data products.
* Strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Stories, SAP People Intelligence, Phenom People, Skillsoft, and other HR technology reporting capabilities.
* Working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, Snowflake, and standard analytics / BI technologies.
* Good understanding of Talent, People \& Culture, HR processes, workforce data, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Good understanding of data modelling, KPI logic, metric definitions, filters, joins, hierarchies, and reporting structures.
* Ability to turn business requirements into practical, accurate, and visually compelling analytics artefacts.
* Ability to explain insights clearly to business users and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, especially for data accuracy, reconciliation, metric logic, access control, and visual design.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and data quality concerns.
* Good understanding of self\-service analytics and how to design products that enable business users to explore data safely.
* Ability to work with business analysts, product owners, data engineers, architects, platform teams, and HR stakeholders.
* Curiosity about new analytics methods, AI\-enabled insight generation, predictive analytics, and data storytelling.


**Academic Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Human Resources, Industrial Psychology, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.
* Certifications or training in SAP SuccessFactors, SAP People Intelligence, SAP Analytics Cloud, Phenom People, Skillsoft, Snowflake, SQL, data visualisation, or Agile would be beneficial.
* Training in people analytics, workforce analytics, HR technology, or responsible data use would be advantageous.


**Required Experience**
* Relevant experience designing and developing HR dashboards, operational reports, embedded analytics, data products, or insight packs.
* Experience building reporting or analytics products in Tier 1 HR applications.
* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors Stories and exposure to SAP People Intelligence, Phenom People, Skillsoft, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar HR technologies.
* Experience translating requirements into reporting outputs, dashboards, metric logic, and data visualisations.
* Experience working with HR, Talent, workforce, learning, recruitment, skills, or employee data.
* Experience with SQL, data validation, metric reconciliation, report testing, and data quality checks would be beneficial.
* Exposure to Snowflake, SAP Business Data Cloud, data warehouses, data lakes, or semantic layers would be advantageous.
* Experience applying data visualisation and storytelling techniques to make insights easier for users to understand.
* Experience supporting dashboard adoption, user training, analytics demonstrations, or self\-service reporting enablement.
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organisation would be beneficial.


**Workplace type:**
 Hybrid Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
   

  

 Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
   

  

 responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
   

  

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
   

  

 application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
   

  

 confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
   

  

 than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
   

  

 established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
   

  

 year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. title: Brand & Marketing Designer
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be the only designer at the company. Everything RenewCO2 puts in front of a customer, a partner, an investor, or a government reviewer passes through you: investor and capability decks, product one\-pagers and spec sheets, the website, booths and signage, social assets, technical diagrams, report layouts, and the brand system holding it all together.
 



 The hard part is not production. It is turning engineering reality into something a non\-specialist understands and a specialist cannot pick apart. You will take a rough sketch, a CAD screenshot, or an Excel chart from an engineer and produce a figure that is accurate first and beautiful second. You will also brief and manage illustrators, 3D artists, videographers, exhibit fabricators, and printers, and hold their work to our standard.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Decks and sales collateral* 



* Design investor, partner, and capability decks end to end, including the dense technical slides — those are the hard ones and they matter most.
* Build PowerPoint and Google Slides template systems with working masters, layouts, and theme colors that non\-designers cannot easily break.
* Produce one\-pagers, spec sheets, technical FAQs, and leave\-behinds that fit real content into a fixed page.



  





*Technical illustration and data visualization* 



* Draw process flow diagrams, system schematics, equipment cutaways, and plant layouts from engineering source material, checking accuracy with our technical team.
* Build charts from raw data — cost curves, comparison bars, mass and energy flow diagrams — with correct axes, units, and honest scales.
* Prepare figures for conference posters, technical papers, and government reports to the conventions those audiences expect.



  





*Website* 



* Design and build pages in our CMS and own the updates, with turnaround measured in hours.
* Hold the line on responsive layout, page performance, on\-page SEO hygiene, and accessibility to WCAG 2\.1 AA.



  





*Brand system* 



* Keep and evolve the RenewCO2 brand system: logo use, typography, color, icons, diagram and chart styles, photography direction, document templates.
* Maintain a component, template, and asset library organized well enough that other people find things in it.



  





*Social, campaigns, and events* 



* Produce social and campaign assets, mostly for LinkedIn: statics, carousels, short motion pieces, event promotion.
* Design booths, banners, signage, and large\-format graphics, and take them through print production and installation by our fabrication vendors.



  





*Vendor art direction* 



* Write the brief, pick the vendor, and manage illustrators, 3D artists, video crews, exhibit fabricators, and print shops to schedule, budget, and quality.
* Review proofs, renders, and cuts, and give feedback specific enough to act on.



  





**What we need to see in your portfolio**




 We read portfolios closely and care more about problem\-solving than polish. Include these and note what you personally did:
 


* A deck you designed end to end. Show us the densest technical slide in it.
* A technical illustration built from an engineer's rough sketch, CAD screenshot, or photograph: a process flow diagram, system schematic, or equipment cutaway.
* Charts you built from raw data, with a note on where the data came from.
* A one\-pager or spec sheet where real technical content, including a table, had to fit a fixed page.
* A website you designed and shipped, with a live link.
* A brand or template system you maintained that other people used correctly without you in the room.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Four to seven years designing in\-house or at an agency, with real work for B2B, industrial, engineering, energy, or scientific clients.
* Figma at an expert level: components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries other people build from.
* Illustrator for vector and technical illustration, InDesign for multi\-page and print\-ready layout, Photoshop for image work.
* Real mastery of PowerPoint and Google Slides. A large share of what we send out is a deck, and engineers will edit it after you hand it over.
* You can design and build in Webflow, WordPress, or something comparable, with an understanding of responsive layout, basic HTML and CSS, image optimization, on\-page SEO, and WCAG 2\.1 AA.
* Print production beyond exporting a PDF: CMYK, Pantone matching, bleed and safe areas, resolution for large\-format graphics, and checking a physical proof.
* You have art\-directed outside vendors — wrote the brief, held the schedule and budget, and gave feedback that improved the work.
* You can work with engineers and scientists. You ask the clarifying question, respect what the data says, and never make a diagram prettier at the cost of making it wrong.
* Disciplined file management: naming conventions, versioning, one source of truth. Sound handling of unpublished technical material under NDA.
* Strong typography and layout judgment, and the ability to explain a decision in plain language to non\-designers. Fluent written and spoken English. Kannada or Hindi helps with local vendors.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* 3D visualization for equipment and plant renders in Blender, KeyShot, or SolidWorks Visualize.
* Motion design for short explainers and animated diagrams in After Effects or Rive.
* Experience preparing figures for journals, conference posters, or government technical reports.
* Photography and video in the lab and on the factory floor, including basic lighting and editing.
* Front\-end comfort past HTML and CSS, or experience with design tokens in a code base.
* Time at an early\-stage company where you set the standard instead of inheriting it.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* A deck and document template system in active use, with fewer off\-brand files circulating each month.
* A refreshed website you can update yourself, quickly, without outside help.
* A library of accurate, reusable diagrams and charts that the commercial and technical teams pull from instead of rebuilding.
* A short vendor bench for print, illustration, 3D, and video, with known costs and lead times.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹12–15 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. No travel, though an extra on\-site day sometimes comes up around a booth build or a print review.
 



  





**What to submit**



* A portfolio link or PDF under 20 MB covering the six items above. Password\-protected is fine — include the password.
* Annotation on every piece: what you designed, built, or art\-directed, and what a team, agency, or vendor did.
* For two projects, a few lines on the brief, the real constraint you worked against, and one decision you would make differently now.
* A live link to a website you designed, with a note on what you designed versus what you built.
* Willingness to open a native file later in the process — a Figma library, an Illustrator diagram, an InDesign document, or a PowerPoint template — and walk us through how it is put together.



  





 Don't send confidential or NDA\-covered work. Redact or describe it. We will not ask for unpaid spec work, and any exercise later in the process gets scoped and paid.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers. The platform collects your CV, work samples, and a few short questions.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

The team focuses on sustainable business models, affordable digital transformation, and building high\-performing, future\-ready healthcare teams. title: Lead Designer (Manager) : DAP
description:
**Who are we?**
 Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human\-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.
   

  

 At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real\-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.
   

  

 This intelligence powers our entire product suite.
   

  

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.


 These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.
   

  

 Our upcoming AI\-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.
   

  

* Seek is an AI\-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2\.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category
* Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise\-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
* Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome\-driven for every employee.
* At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
* The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40\+ countries.
* Customers: 700\+ enterprise customers, including 80\+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
* Investors: A total of \~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2\. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.


**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**
* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI\-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5\+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025\)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4\.6 on G2 Crowd, 4\.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super\-high CSAT of 99\.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software \- 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”


**These recognitions are matched by business performance:**
* Highest\-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times \& Statista's High\-Growth Companies Asia\-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022\-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal
* Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion\-dollar company!


**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Design Lead to join our Product Design and UXUser Research team, where you'll help define our DAP experience strategy and guide a team of talented designers toward successful outcomes.
   

  

 This role is both strategic and hands\-on, ideal for someone who thrives in a player\-coach capacity. You'll play a key role in expanding the DAP category and shaping how our multiple products work together to create greater value, developing strategies that seamlessly integrate them to drive cohesive, user\-centered solutions across the ecosystem.
   

  

 As a design leader, you can coach and support your teams to thrive in fast\-paced, hyper\-growth environments. You’ll have experience working with product and engineering leaders throughout the product development life\-cycle as you manage and support your design team.
   

  

 Our designers are strong strategic thinkers and problem solvers who work on industry\-defining innovations that are creating a new category. As our ideal candidate, you can oversee, support, and empower the designers to do their best work. You’re capable of zooming out to set the team vision and drilling down to the details to help solution and assess the polish of the work.
   

  

 You understand the importance of building a strong team culture, building trust, creating collaborative relationships with our product and engineering partners to innovative solutions through human\-centered design, and upskilling everyone around them in the process.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and manage Design for our DAP Tribe, one of 4 Tribes within Whatfix
* Work with Design leadership and cross\-functional partners to align DAP strategy to overall business goals and product strategy.
* Help to define the DAP design vision that supports our product strategy and actively align design teams efforts to achieve it.
* Drive the design quality, practice, and offerings for our DAP product line that meet our business, customer, and end\-user goals.
* Lead and mentor a team of DAP designers through the end\-to\-end design process, championing and encouraging innovation, creative thinking, new ideas and solutions.
* Own craft and capability output across key DAP projects, ensuring each project deliverable is of the highest quality and meets the Design teams defined standards.
* Represent the needs and voice of the user wrt to our DAP offering, championing these needs with cross\-functional partners to help prioritize planning and process.
* Act as a strategic partner to product and technology leads on DAP to ensure prioritization and delivery of key products and features through an inclusive design process.
* Assess performance and provide career guidance for members of the DAP design team.


**What We’re Looking For:**
* Industry Experience: 8\-12 years relevant industry experience, with 2\-3 of those years managing designers as a player\-coach. We’re looking for design leaders who know when and how to roll up their sleeves to multiply their teams.
* Fostering Creative Environments: Experience creating environments where design teams can do high\-quality, creative, hypothesis\-driven work.
* Human centered approach: Proven experience with driving and applying human\-centered design processes while collaborating with customers, engineering, product management, and user researchers.

 Information Technology

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable
   

  

 rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.
   

  

 This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.
   

  

 You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers
   

  

 who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 UX Standards and Consistency
   

  

* Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
* Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
* Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
* Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.


 Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption
   

  

* Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
* Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use


 it to drive design decisions.
   

  

* Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
* Bring an outside\-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.


 Hands On Design and Build
   

  

* Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
* Write front\-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
* Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
* Set front\-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.


 User Research and Accessibility
   

  

* Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
* Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
* Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.


 Mobile Experience
   

  

* Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keeps it that way as the platform grows.
* Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile apps and mobile web.


 Building the UX Practice and Team
   

  

* Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the ways of working.
* Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and user obsession are the norm.
* Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front\-end work across everyone building on the platform.


 Stakeholder Management and Communication
   

  

* Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them around a shared bar for quality.
* Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
* Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep hands on experience with ServiceNow native UX capabilities, including UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework, across workspaces, portals, and Employee Center.
* Hands on front\-end development experience with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to build production experiences directly.
* Proven track record building and owning a design system and component library adopted across multiple teams.
* Experience establishing and documenting UX and UI standards and driving their adoption at scale.
* Hands on user research experience, including usability testing and translating findings into design decisions.
* Strong accessibility expertise, including WCAG 2\.1 / 2\.2 and designing for assistive technologies.
* A portfolio that shows consumer grade enterprise experiences, and the judgment to move a platform beyond legacy and ITSM era patterns.
* Proven people leadership. You have built or led a team of designers and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive leadership.
* Experience owning the adoption and success of what you ship, and measuring it.
* Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools.
* 8\+ years in UX and UI design, with meaningful time in a lead or player\-coach capacity.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow certifications related to UX, UI Builder, or application development (e.g., CSA, CAD).
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow mobile, including Now Mobile and the mobile app builder.
* Experience standing up a UX or design ops practice inside an organization that previously had none.
* Experience turning around the reputation of a platform or product that had outgrown its original design.
* Familiarity with Employee Center Pro intranet and portal experiences.
* Experience with design system tooling such as Storybook, design tokens, and component documentation.
* Interaction and motion design skills, and UX writing or content design experience.
* Experience working with large scale enterprise design systems.

title: Product Experience Lead
description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. Our customers are mid\-market companies, many in regulated industries.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated product experience hire. You'll own how both products feel, from the first click to the hundredth workflow.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why
* Use Claude Design, Figma and code prototypes to explore quickly, then spend your time choosing and refining
* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools



  





 Bonus points if you've designed AI or agent products, worked in a regulated industry, or can prototype in code.
 



  





 This role probably isn't for you if your best work is Dribbble shots rather than outcomes, or if you'd rather hand off mockups and move on.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on\-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* A consistent, high\-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on\-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one\-pagers, and sales/product collateral
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn\-first), including post series and campaign templates
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short\-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on\-brand output
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent
* At least 3\+ years in a design role, ideally in\-house at a B2B SaaS product\-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work
* Fast, high\-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like
* Detail\-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi\-page, print\-ready layouts for case studies and collateral
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on\-brand across personas and campaigns
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high\-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short\-form social edits
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on\-system as the brand scales
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender)
* Presentation design: high\-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI\-assisted layout, prompt\-based workflows, and AI video
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth
* AI\-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast\-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross\-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.
* Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.
* Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI\-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.
* Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on\-brand and right.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.
* Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade\-offs.


 Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Job description:** 




  





 The Graphic Designer will be part of Factory U/X team and will work on industrial visual communication as well as complete workplace\-experience environments. The role involves transforming complex safety, operational and organizational information into clear, engaging and visually powerful communication.
 



  




* The designer will contribute to projects such as:
* Customer Experience Centers Safety Experience Centers
* Training and Innovation Centers
* TPM and DWM Galleries
* Factory\-wide visual\-management programmes
* Workplace branding and culture communication
* Wayfinding and navigation systems
* Safety and behavior\-change campaigns
* Interactive and digital workplace displays



  





**The person must be comfortable developing a design direction, visualizing it within a physical space and converting the approved concept into accurate, production\-ready artwork.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Workplace and Experience Design** 



* Develop visual concepts for Customer Experience Centers, Safety Experience Centers, Training Centers, TPM/DWM Galleries and other workplace\-experience environments.
* Translate a central concept into a cohesive physical experience across walls, displays, digital screens, installations and interactive elements.
* Create mood boards, spatial themes, wall elevations and realistic mock\-ups using site photographs, dimensions and architectural references.
* Work with project, content, fabrication and installation teams to ensure the final execution remains consistent with the approved design.



  





**2\. Industrial Visual Communication** 



* Design factory\-wide safety communication, visual\-management systems, workplace branding, wayfinding, process displays and behavior\-change campaigns.
* Simplify complex safety, technical and operational information into communication that is clear, engaging and easy to understand.
* Develop a consistent visual language across multiple artworks, locations and audience groups.
* Work within customer brand guidelines while maintaining the intended communication and design quality



  





**3\. Production Artwork** 



* Convert approved concepts into accurate, production\-ready artwork for large\-format printing and different fabrication applications.
* Adapt master designs across multiple sizes, formats, languages and site locations.
* Ensure accuracy in dimensions, scale, bleed, colour modes, image resolution, cut lines, fonts and file packaging.
* Conduct final quality checks and maintain systematic file naming, version control and artwork archives.



  





**4\. AI\-Assisted Design** 



* Use AI tools for concept exploration, image generation, visual references, retouching and faster artwork adaptation.
* Write effective prompts to generate industry\- and brand\-relevant visual content. Professionally refine AI\-generated outputs and check them for accuracy, realism and production suitability.
* Follow company guidelines on confidentiality, copyright and responsible use of AI.



  





**5\. Project Coordination and Quality** 



* Understand project briefs, technical content, site conditions and customer requirements before beginning the design.
* Participate in internal reviews and customer presentations when required, and incorporate feedback accurately.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve design, production and implementation\-related issues.
* Manage multiple assignments while maintaining quality, consistency and agreed timelines.



  





**Experience and Educational Background** 




  




* 3–4 years of relevant professional design experience.
* Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Applied Arts or a related discipline.
* Experience with a design agency, environmental\-graphics company, workplace\-branding firm, exhibition or experience\-design company, or large\-format production organization.
* Experience in industrial communication, safety communication, environmental graphics, wayfinding or experience\-center design will be strongly preferred



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop and CorelDRAW.
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and information layout.
* Good image\-editing, photo\-manipulation and retouching skills.
* Ability to create realistic design mock\-ups using actual site photographs.
* Understanding of environmental graphics, spatial storytelling and experience\-led design. Ability to visualize a complete physical environment not just an individual poster or signage.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini or equivalent platforms.
* Experience preparing artwork for small\-format and large\-format printing.
* Ability to interpret measurements, drawings, site photographs and marked\-up presentations.
* Ability to work with customer brand guidelines and established visual systems.
* Good command of written English and the ability to identify basic content errors.
* Strong attention to detail, especially while handling safety and technical information.



  





**Application Requirements** 




  




* Updated résumé.
* Portfolio containing 8–12 relevant projects.
* Examples of branding, environmental graphics, spatial design, signage, layouts or largeformat production work.
* At least one project demonstrating how complete physical space was visualized.
* Examples of AI\-assisted design work, with a brief explanation of how AI was used.
* Current compensation is expected compensation and notice period.

title: Creative Lead
description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Creative Lead for Production owns quality and pipeline health for a pod of designers delivering creative across Video, Banner, Native, Interstitial, and Playable formats. You are the QA gate — every asset passes through your sign\-off before it ships.
   

  

 You sit at the seam between Creative Strategy and Production: translating briefs into executable direction, maintaining the team's output velocity, and protecting quality even at peak volume (20–30 tickets per day). This is not a pure management role. You are expected to stay hands\-on — personally concepting, storyboarding, and executing — while leading, coaching, and developing your direct reports.
   

  

 The right person sets the creative bar rather than enforcing someone else's, and finds the balance between forward output and quality control without dropping either.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own production quality standards across all formats and enforce the QA matrix — every asset passes your sign\-off before shipping

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Runable:** 




  





 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. Our users are business owners and operators, not power users of software, so how clear the product feels decides whether it gets adopted at all.
 



  





**The Role:** 




  





 We are hiring a UI/UX Designer to own the experience of what we ship — from the messy problem to the pixels engineers build against. You will do both halves of the job: the thinking that decides what a screen should do, and the craft that makes it look like it was designed on purpose.
 



 This is a small team, so you will own product areas outright rather than decorating someone else's flows. Expect to sit with real customer problems, work directly with engineers, and see your designs live within weeks. Our users are non\-technical and time\-poor — every unnecessary step you remove is the actual output of this role.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end design for product areas: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and prototypes.
* Turn vague requests and customer pain into clear, shippable design solutions with a defensible rationale.
* Design for clarity over cleverness — our users are SMB operators who need to get one thing done fast.
* Build and extend our design system: components, patterns, tokens, and documentation that keep the product coherent.
* Work directly with engineers through implementation, reviewing builds and fixing the gap between design and shipped UI.
* Prototype interactions and motion where static screens cannot answer the question.
* Run lightweight research and usability testing — talk to users, watch them struggle, change the design.
* Use analytics and session data to find where people drop off, then design and measure the fix.
* Design responsive interfaces that hold up across desktop and mobile, with accessibility treated as a default.
* Contribute to marketing and brand surfaces when needed — landing pages, in\-product education, and launch assets.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 4–8 years designing digital products, with a portfolio of shipped work — not concept pieces.
* Currently managing a design team of at least 2–4 people, with direct responsibility for their work and growth.
* Strong UI craft: layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, and spacing discipline you can explain rather than eyeball.
* Genuine UX ability: you can map a flow, simplify a process, and justify structure with user reasoning.
* Expert in Figma — components, auto\-layout, variants, and prototypes that engineers can actually work from.
* Experience designing SaaS, dashboards, or complex workflow tools where information density is a real problem.
* Working understanding of front\-end constraints and comfortable collaborating closely with engineers.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* Comfortable using AI tools to move faster — exploring directions, generating assets, and cutting production time.
* Able to present and defend design decisions to founders and engineers, and to change your mind when the argument is better.
* Self\-driven in a low\-process environment: you find the problems worth designing for instead of waiting for tickets.



  





**Nice to Have:** 




  




* Startup experience where you were the only or first designer.
* Experience designing for non\-technical or SMB audiences.
* Interaction and motion design skill (Rive, Lottie, After Effects, or Figma's motion tooling).
* Ability to build with front\-end code or AI app builders to ship simple things yourself.
* Illustration, iconography, or brand design range.
* Exposure to AI\-native product patterns — chat, agents, generative interfaces.



  





**Why Runable:** 




  




* Real ownership: your design decisions ship, and you see how SMB customers respond within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — design quality is a company\-level differentiator here, not a finishing step.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Room to shape the design system and the product's visual direction as we scale.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**
 ServiceTitan strives to be the best place our Titans have ever worked, so they can do the best work they've ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team is central to this mission. We solve real\-world problems in the home services industry, bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional workflows. Our product designers work closely with product managers, engineers, product marketers, and thousands of our users to make their lives easier through technology, including Titan Intelligence, our AI platform. We embrace agile development and design thinking to ship dozens of new features every month, and we measure our success by our customers' success.
   

  

 We're building out our Bangalore design team and looking for a talented AI\-First Staff Product Designer who enjoys solving complex problems with data\-driven, AI\-powered solutions. This person will design experiences that put Titan Intelligence at the core of the product, not bolted on as an afterthought, across desktop, tablet, and mobile touchpoints. You'll bring a balanced toolkit of research, interface design, and prototyping capabilities, with real fluency in designing for AI\-driven and agentic workflows.
   

  

 As a Staff Product Designer, you're capable of running discovery research with users, creating journey maps and task flows, conducting user interviews, whiteboarding task flows, mocking up interface screens, and prototyping solutions for testing \- including AI\-assisted prototyping tools that speed up how fast ideas go from concept to validation. You set a strong example and provide thoughtful direction within the team, often acting as a mentor and coach. You're known across the company for your creativity, leadership, and innovation.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to shape one of the largest platforms disrupting the home services industry, and to help define what AI\-first product design looks like at ServiceTitan's growing Bangalore hub.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Build positive, collaborative relationships across product, engineering, and research to explore, build, and ship your work
* Develop deep expertise across multiple product problem areas, with a focus on where Titan Intelligence and AI capabilities can meaningfully improve the experience
* Design human\-AI interaction patterns, including agentic workflows, confidence and trust cues, human\-in\-the\-loop review steps, and graceful handling of AI uncertainty or error
* Quickly prototype solutions to visual and interaction problems, using AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools to accelerate iteration
* Talk to users to understand their problems, current pain points, and comfort level with AI\-driven features
* Design experiences that are simple, elegant, and solve real problems
* Use remote tools to whiteboard, create wireframes, and design in Figma, iterating toward a shippable solution
* Validate product ideas through experimental design and research approaches, including testing AI feature outputs for usefulness and trust
* Ship valuable, high\-quality work without sacrificing speed
* Help more junior designers build empathy for our users and advocate for user needs, especially as AI changes how they work
* Represent our users in product strategy and roadmap discussions
* Review product design work and give constructive feedback
* Actively mentor designers, helping them build context, strong decision\-making skills, and empathy for our users.


**What You’ll Bring:**
* Experience designing B2B products, particularly modern SaaS or enterprise platforms
* Strong UX reasoning, with a proven ability to solve complex, ambiguous product problems through simple design solutions
* Direct experience designing AI\-powered or AI\-assisted product features \- for example, generative AI, recommendation systems, copilots, or agentic workflows \- with a clear point of view on how to make AI experiences trustworthy and useful
* An outstanding portfolio showing a range of UX, interaction, and visual design work, plus idea generation or prototyping used to explore and convey design solutions
* Deep experience with UX research and end\-to\-end ownership, taking a problem from discovery through shipped solution
* Startup or fast\-paced environment experience, with the self\-starter mindset to match
* High attention to detail in both visual design and copy
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain the "why" behind your design rationale to your team and stakeholders
* A thought partner and leader others turn to for design judgment and point of view
* At least one year of experience directly managing a team of two or more people


 ‌
   

  

**Be Human With Us:**
 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
   

  

**Use of AI Technology:**
 We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.
   

  

 At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Lottie Creator (App Experience)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 About The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Motion Designer \& Lottie Creator to own the visual design and animation for our highest\-impact app real estate: the homepage masthead. You will own the complete end\-to\-end creative pipeline: designing static vector assets from scratch based on product briefs, and then animating them into high\-performance, lightweight Lottie files. Working at the intersection of visual illustration, motion craft, and product performance, you will ensure every asset looks premium, loads instantly, and runs smoothly on entry\-level smartphones across India.
   

  

 Focus Area 1: End\-to\-End Asset Design \& Motion
   

  

* Illustration \& Vector Asset Creation: Design custom, high\-quality static vector illustrations, icons, and visual UI assets in Figma/Illustrator that align with brand guidelines and category needs.
* Lottie Animation \& Craft: Turn your static designs into smooth, expressive Lottie animations using After Effects, bringing product concepts (like digital gold or credit cards) to life.
* Homepage Masthead Real Estate: Own the visual presentation of primary homepage banners, ensuring designs drive immediate category recognition and high tap\-through rates.
* Category Visual Storytelling: Translate complex financial products into simple, intuitive visual metaphors that guide user navigation.


 Focus Area 2: Product Alignment \& Technical Optimization
   

  

* Performance \& Asset Compression: Optimize JSON and Lottie files to ensure minimal file sizes and low memory usage, preventing app lag or battery drain.
* Device Compatibility \& Accessibility: Test and optimize animations across a wide spectrum of mobile devices, ensuring seamless playback on entry\-level Android smartphones and varied screen sizes.
* Design Systems Integration: Work alongside the core UI/UX team to maintain consistent design tokens, color usage, and visual style across all custom illustrations.


 Focus Area 3: Motion Analytics \& Performance Optimization
   

  

* Tap\-Through \& Conversion Tracking: Collaborate with product analysts to review performance data on masthead assets, understanding how visual design and animation variations impact click\-through rates.
* Iterative Testing: Design and test different visual styles, layout compositions, and animation speeds to continuously improve user engagement across categories.


**Qualifications**
 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Full\-Pipeline Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both static visual/illustration design skills (Figma/Illustrator) and complex vector motion design (After Effects to Lottie).
* Technical Performance Mastery: Deep understanding of Lottie runtime limitations, vector optimization, layer structuring, keyframe efficiency, and JSON file size constraints for high\-scale apps.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Proven experience working alongside Product Managers, Engineers, and UI/UX Designers to ship live app features.


 Mindset To Succeed
   

  

* Designer \+ Animator Hybrid: You take equal pride in drawing the clean, static vector illustration as you do in bringing it to life with motion.
* High\-Scale User Focus: You understand our diverse user base and ensure your designs look great and play smoothly on simple, entry\-level smartphones.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of the homepage motion experience, proactively spotting dated assets and pitching new visual concepts to product teams.


**Additional Information**
 PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
   

  

 Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Visual Communication Designer
description:
***Techrowth Pvt. Ltd. · Bengaluru — on\-site · 6\-month internship with a pre\-placement offer on the table***




***Stipend: ₹30,000/month · PPO: ₹5\.5–8\.5 LPA on conversion***




  




***The short version***

  





*We're looking for a designer who doesn't stay in one lane. Someone who can build an identity system on Monday, storyboard a 30\-second film on Wednesday, and walk a client through the thinking on Friday without losing the room.* 




*This is a six\-month internship that exists to become a full\-time job. We're not hiring interns to fill a gap, we're hiring the person we want on the team, and using six months to make sure we're both right about it.* 




*You won't be handed a template and asked to resize it. You'll be in the room where the problem gets defined which means you need taste, range, and the ability to explain why you made the choice you made.* 




  




***What you'll actually do***

  




* *Design across formats: identity systems, campaign visuals, social, packaging, motion, editorial, decks, and whatever the brief demands next*
* *Translate a strategy or a rough brief into visual directions — usually more than one, always with a point of view*
* *Present your work. Out loud. To people who will push back. Defend what's right, drop what isn't*
* *Work through revisions without losing the original idea*
* *Keep systems tight: type scales, grids, colour, file hygiene, handoff that doesn't break*
* *Sit in on strategy and client conversations, take notes, and come back with something nobody asked for but everybody needed*



  




***Who this is for***

  





*An undergraduate who is hungry not for a title, but for reps. For the kind of range you only get by shipping a lot of work, fast, under real constraints, with someone senior telling you exactly what's wrong with it.* 




*If you've been making things outside your coursework zines, posters for a friend's gig, a rebrand nobody asked for, an Instagram account where you post type experiments, we want to see that more than we want to see your final\-year submission.* 




  




***What we're looking for***

  





***Non\-negotiable***



* *A portfolio with a point of view. 3 pieces you can defend beats forty you can't*
* *Genuine multidisciplinary range, you're not just a poster person or just a UI person*
* *Strong communication. You can write a clear email, run a review, and explain a design decision in plain language. This matters as much as the craft*
* *Command of the tools: Adobe CS (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma.*
* *The ability to take blunt feedback without deflating, and to push back when you're right.*
* *Available for six months on\-site in Bengaluru.*



***Bonus points***



* *Motion (After Effects) or 3D (Blender)*
* *Illustration or hand\-lettering in your own voice*
* *Photography, art direction, or a sense for how a shoot comes together*
* *Indian type and vernacular design sensibility*
* *A side project you've kept alive for more than six months*



  




***The money, plainly***

  





  





***On conversion:***
*₹5\.5–8\.5 LPA. Where you land in that band is decided by the six months, not by your resume. What moves you up it:* 



* *Range — how many formats you can own end to end without supervision*
* *Independence — how much of a brief you can take from kickoff to delivery alone*
* *Client\-facing ability — whether we can put you in a room with a client and relax*
* *Craft consistency — your worst piece, not your best one*



*We'll tell you where you're tracking at the three\-month mark, so the conversion conversation holds no surprises.* 




  




***What else you get***

  




* *Direct mentorship — reviews with senior folks, not feedback relayed through three layers*
* *Real client work with your fingerprints on it, from week two*
* *Exposure to the strategy behind the work, not just the execution brief*
* *A portfolio that looks very different six months from now*



  




***This role is not for you if***

  




* *You want a fixed scope and a clear lane*
* *You'd rather send the file than present the file*
* *You think feedback is a personal matter*
* *You're treating this as a semester requirement rather than a job you want*

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Stripe is investing in building out its Creative Design team within the Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) to reach users across the globe. The team designs comprehensive ad campaigns tailored for various platforms, ensuring that every visual element aligns with our marketing goals and engages our audience effectively. We create net\-new creative content and localize and adapt our work to meet the unique cultural and linguistic needs of different regions, presenting our message effectively in global languages.
   

  

 In addition to advertising and web content, we produce high\-quality designs for presentations and collateral aimed at large users and executive audiences. Our designs enhance the clarity and impact of our messages, making complex information accessible and engaging—whether for a client pitch or an executive strategy session.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Designers at Stripe's SDC bring a passion for captivating storytelling and great design. They use design systems to tell compelling stories to a variety of audiences, and are well\-versed at expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible design systems that achieve bar\-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. They are user\-focused, business\-savvy, empathetic, and inspiring. The ideal candidate excels across a variety of styles, crisply articulates design decisions, iterates quickly, and collaborates seamlessly with marketers, product managers, leaders, other designers, and cross\-functional partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ideate, design, and produce world\-class design solutions—both static and motion—across a range of deliverables including presentations, posters, brand art, and signage.
* Steward designers through large\-scale projects, providing art direction and ongoing guidance on creative strategy, execution, and localization.
* Work across a wide variety of mediums (physical, digital, and everything in between) to create immersive storytelling and creative content that brings Stripe's brand and product stories to life.
* Bring design concepts to life through storyboarding, comps, and creative presentations, iterating based on stakeholder feedback and internal testing.
* Collaborate with copywriters, static and motion designers, marketers, and ad operations to develop visionary concepts that engage a global audience.
* Mentor designers in best practices and ideation, fostering an environment where everyone learns and grows.
* Present ideas in a clear, focused way that builds consensus within the team and with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify and implement process improvements through automation and AI integration to enhance design quality and efficiency.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of relevant design and art direction experience, with a focus on technical or product\-driven companies.
* Strong track record of independently delivering high\-quality work and influencing the output of other designers and cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Figma, Canva, and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (motion and statics).
* Experience managing or mentoring a team of designers.
* Ability to express and communicate a brand through distinct graphics, patterns, motion, interaction, and experiences.
* A hands\-on maker with the skills to effectively communicate concepts, direction, and decisions to teams and external partners.
* Ability to balance speed and quality, consistently delivering challenging, interesting, and pixel\-perfect work.
* Persuasive and receptive to feedback; able to clearly explain work, process, and decisions.
* Comfortable working flexible hours, including late evenings (IST), to collaborate in real time with global stakeholders.
* Highly detail\-oriented, with a drive for pixel\-perfect craft.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multidisciplinary creative comfortable working across different mediums and excited about experimenting with new technologies.
* Prior people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and growing design talent.
* Experienced at facilitating stakeholder alignment and advocating for design quality.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now
