description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.
   

  

 You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Product Designer at Coram AI, you’ll design the end\-to\-end experience for an AI\-native video security platform used by security and operations teams to monitor, investigate, and respond to real\-world incidents. You’ll turn complex workflows (live video, AI detections, multi\-site operations, access control, and incident response) into intuitive, high\-confidence product experiences.
   

  

 You’ll have significant ownership from day one: partnering closely with product managers and engineers, speaking directly with customers, and taking work from early concepts through polished, production\-ready designs. This is a high\-impact role for a systems\-minded designer who enjoys solving technically complex B2B problems, building scalable design foundations, and shipping quickly in an early\-stage environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product design process from early customer discovery and wireframing to high\-fidelity visual design, interactive prototyping, and developer handoff
* Design workflows for natural language video search, custom AI alert setup, interactive camera walls, and incident deep\-dive investigations
* Streamline critical operations like multi\-site security oversight, role\-based access control, visitor management, and emergency response coordination
* Build, expand, and maintain Coram AI’s UI component library and design system in Figma to ensure speed, accessibility, and visual consistency across desktop and mobile
* Talk directly with security operators, IT directors, and facility leaders to understand workflows, iterate on user feedback, and validate design solutions
* Collaborate daily with PMs and front\-end/AI engineers in a fast\-paced, high\-ship\-velocity environment


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation package
* Attractive Health benefits for you and family
* Flexible paid time off
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Referral bonuses


**Skills And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a proven track record building complex B2B SaaS platforms, data\-dense web applications, or AI tools
* Clear case studies demonstrating end\-to\-end design execution, complex problem solving, high visual polish, and systemic UI thinking
* Expertise in component architecture, autolayout, prototyping, and design system governance
* Ability to understand technical constraints surrounding live\-video streams, real\-time telemetry, and AI detection models to design viable, elegant solutions
* Thrives in early\-to\-growth stage environments; proactive, self\-directed, and capable of executing independently with minimal guidance
* Prior design experience in video management (VMS), IoT monitoring, cybersecurity, hardware/software hybrid platforms, or developer/AI tooling is a plus
* Familiarity with front\-end code (HTML/CSS/React/Tailwind) or mobile application design is a plus
* Experience designing for high\-urgency, critical\-incident UI scenarios (e.g., dispatch centers, emergency response tools, operational control rooms) is a plus


 We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.
   

  

 Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

 You will join the
 **Fulfilment and Experience (F\&E)** 
 team at Meesho. F\&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India’s most cost\-efficient, reliable, and scalable e\-commerce network, serving
 **100M\+ monthly active users** 
 .
   

  

 From disintermediating traditional logistics through
 **Valmo** 
 (Meesho’s unbundled micro\-entrepreneur supply platform) to driving zero\-commission seller enablement and real\-time speed platforms, F\&E operates at the intersection of deep systems thinking, network engineering, and structural innovation. **About The Role**
 This role offers a direct mandate to reshape a function that touches every single Meesho order, with full autonomy over team structure, roadmap, and how you solve the problem. * Order\-to\-delivery experience — speed, reliability, and predictability of the fulfillment promise
* Post\-order experience — returns, refunds, and how fast/painlessly they resolve
* Customer support — treating support volume as a signal to fix root causes, not just a queue to clear
* The fast delivery network bet — reimagining what "fast" means for value e\-commerce, and what infrastructure/network changes get us there
* A team of 10–15 — you'll build, coach, and scale a pod of builders (not just managers)

* Excellent stakeholder management — you'll work closely with Product, Ops, 3PLs, and Meesho leadership

**About Target**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
   

  

 Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are currently hiring for the Advanced AI Pyramid at Target. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll help shape how Target designs AI\-enabled and agentic experiences, from early interaction models through to patterns other teams can build on. This role focuses on tools and workflows used by technical and product teams building these experiences, while flexing to other guest and team member experiences as priorities evolve.
   

  

 You'll work through open, evolving problems alongside product and engineering, turning early ideas into direction a team can build against. Much of this work is systems\-level: a pattern needs to hold up across multiple teams and use cases, not just one screen
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and prototype agentic experiences: multi\-agent entry points, cross\-domain surfaces, and the moments where a system's reasoning needs to be visible and trustworthy.
* Build fast demonstrations that give internal teams something concrete to react to.
* Work directly with product teams adopting agentic AI. Take their early idea and shape it into a real product direction alongside their engineering counterparts.
* Design how trust and autonomy actually show up in an experience: guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop moments, and how the system's provenance is surfaced to the person using it.
* Hold your work to a high standard across journey maps, flows, and prototypes. Think about whether a pattern holds up beyond the specific team it started with.
* Few precedents exist for this kind of work, so you'll often be inventing the approach as much as the product. Look to the industry for what's working elsewhere, but expect to build new methods where nothing established fits.


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\+ years in product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows you can think past a single user and a single interface, beyond screen\-level craft alone.
* Direct exposure to AI/agentic product design, developer experience design, or adjacent work like complex workflow tools, platform/infrastructure UX, or design systems at enterprise scale. You should already be building in this space in some form, even outside a formal role.

**Nice to Have**
* Some technical fluency \- API literacy, design\-to\-code tools, or comfort prototyping with code, so you can move fast without waiting on an engineer for every iteration.
* Experience contributing to a design system.
* The ability to walk someone through why you made a decision, beyond what the final screens look like.
* Writing, talks, side projects, or anything else that shows genuine interest in this space. Doesn't need to be public \- sharing it alongside your portfolio works too.


**A Note on Fit**
 Take this role if you'd rather help define how this practice works than step into one that's already set. You should be as interested in how trust and autonomy should feel as in what an agent can technically do. Expect to be building the ground you're standing on.

description:
About
 **Bright Money** 




  






 Bright
 
 Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle\-income consumers living paycheck\-to\-paycheck.
 



  





 Bright is a profitable, India\-built, U.S.\-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 12 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial service marketplace revenues for loans, credit cards, and credit\-building tools.
 



  





 Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI\-driven Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers.
 



  





 The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle\-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.
 



  





 Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





 Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex\-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data\-driven, fast\-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.
 



  





**What is the team \& role about?** 




  





 We are seeking a Junior Product Designer with a passion for finding solutions that allow customers to intuitively use our products. The ideal candidate is eager to grow at every stage of the design process, excited to use AI to design and build faster, and always focused on the needs of the customer. You will work with other designers and cross\-functional team members, and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.
 



  




* You will receive training in building incredible products and features from highly experienced consumer product veterans.

**What you will do?** 




  




* Collaborate with teammates across product and engineering to define, build, and release new products and features.
* Construct user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that effectively communicate design concepts for validation.
* Use AI tools to explore ideas and move to high\-fidelity quickly, and experiment with vibe\-coding prototypes to test concepts in the real product.

* Participate in user interviews and research to better understand customer needs.
* Stay curious about how the best AI products are evolving their UI/UX, and bring those learnings into your work.
* Contribute thinking to product features and the roadmap.
* Contribute to and positively shape the design team's culture through collaboration, feedback, and process iteration.



  





**Ideal candidate profile looks like?** 




**Experience \& Background:** 




  




* 0\-1 years of UI/UX experience with a relevant degree in Human Centered Design, or a related field of study.
* Curiosity and eagerness to use AI design and prototyping tools to raise both the speed and the quality of your work.
* Willingness to build simple functional prototypes, including through vibe\-coding, to pressure\-test ideas.
* Strong design craft skills including interaction, visual, and service design.
* A strong grasp of tools like Figma, the Adobe suite, and prototyping tools.
* Ability to understand business objectives, direction, and needs expressed from multiple inputs ranging from marketing, business, and technical teams.
* Experience across the design process including user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design, and usability testing.
* Interest in designing mobile app interfaces for consumer products.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of web and mobile design and interface guidelines.
* Curiosity for user experience research, both to design new products and to improve existing ones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to discuss and convey design principles and strategies to stakeholders.
* Strong product thinking and a desire to collaborate closely with PMs and engineers.
* An excellent portfolio that demonstrates systematic and creative design thinking, as well as a strong understanding of best practices.
* Passion for a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.



  





**What Bright Offers?** 




  




* A profitable sub\-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P\&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data\-driven, high\-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor — Growth Team
   


**Location:** 
 Bangalore — Work From Office, Near RMZ Infinity, Old Madras Road
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹4–6 LPA
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 Kloth.me
 



  




 About Kloth
 
 Kloth is building a new way to shop for fashion — combining
 **AI, content and commerce** 
 to make discovering and buying clothes far more visual, personalised and effortless.
 



 Content is one of our biggest growth levers, and we're looking for a
 **Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor** 
 who can help us create content people actually stop scrolling for.
 



 We don't just want polished videos.
 



 We want
 **strong visual ideas, unexpected hooks, great motion and edits that have a real shot at beating the odds of going viral.** 



 The Role
 
 You'll sit within Kloth's
 **Growth Team** 
 and work closely with our content and performance marketing teams.
 



 This is a
 **motion\-graphics\-heavy role with significant video editing requirements.** 




**You'll take concepts, scripts, raw footage, product images, screenshots, typography, memes and AI\-generated assets and turn them into highly engaging short\-form content.** 




**Expect to ship 30–40 short\-form video edits every week.** 



 What You'll Do
 * Create high\-quality
 **motion graphics and animated content** 
 for Reels, ads and social media
* Edit
 **20–30 short\-form videos every week**
* **Design strong visual hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds**
* **Animate typography, UI elements, product imagery, illustrations and graphic assets**
* **Create transitions, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects and motion\-led storytelling**
* **Turn relatively simple raw footage into highly engaging content through editing and motion design**
* **Build performance advertising creatives and rapidly produce multiple variations of winning concepts**
* **Work closely with the content team on scripts, hooks, storyboards and the weekly content calendar**
* **Translate creative concepts into formats that feel native to Instagram and other short\-form platforms**
* **Use AI video and image\-generation tools** 
 to create assets, scenes, effects and experimental content
* Develop reusable motion templates that allow us to increase creative output without making everything look templated
* Review performance data and help iterate on creatives based on what is actually working


 Motion Graphics Skills We're Looking For
 
 You should be highly comfortable with:
 


* **Adobe After Effects**
* **Adobe Premiere Pro**
* **Photoshop / Illustrator**
* **Canva**



 Strong skills in the following are especially valuable:
 


* Kinetic typography
* Text animation
* Motion tracking
* Masking and rotoscoping
* Compositing
* Keyframe animation
* Speed ramping
* Motion blur
* Transitions
* Product animation
* UI animation
* Sound design
* Colour correction
* Green\-screen / background replacement
* Creating motion systems and reusable templates



 You don't need to be a VFX wizard.
 



 But you should be able to look at a fairly ordinary piece of footage and think:
 



**"How do I make this dramatically more interesting?"** 



 Video Editing Matters Just as Much
 
 Motion graphics is the core skill, but this is
 **not a pure animation role** 
 .
 



 A significant part of your job will involve editing real footage.
 



 You should have a strong instinct for:
 


* Hooks
* Pacing
* Jump cuts
* Music
* Sound effects
* Captions
* Reaction shots
* Pattern interrupts
* Story progression
* Retention editing
* Creating multiple cuts of the same idea



 You should understand that a great short\-form edit is often less about cinematic perfection and more about
 **keeping someone watching for another second.** 



 AI Skills Matter
 
 We expect you to actively use generative AI as part of your creative workflow.
 



 You should be comfortable experimenting with tools for:
 


* Text\-to\-video
* Image\-to\-video
* AI\-generated scenes
* AI characters and avatars
* Image generation
* Generative visual effects
* Voice generation
* Background replacement
* AI\-assisted editing
* Concept prototyping



 We don't care whether your favourite tool today is Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney or something released three weeks from now.
 



 We care that you're constantly figuring out
 **what AI lets you create that wasn't practical before.** 



 You Should Also Be a Content Thinker
 
 We don't want someone who waits for a perfectly written brief and then opens After Effects.
 



 You'll be expected to actively contribute ideas.
 



 That means participating in:
 


* Content brainstorming
* Writing hooks
* Improving scripts
* Storyboarding
* Trend spotting
* Developing recurring content formats
* Ad creative ideation
* Content calendar planning



 You'll work with marketers and content creators, but you should be capable of saying:
 



**"This opening won't work. Let's try this instead."** 



 What Success Looks Like
 
 Your work should help Kloth create content that makes people:
 



**Stop. Watch. Share. Click. Buy.** 




**We'll care about things like:** 



* Creative output
* Speed
* Watch time and retention
* Hook performance
* Shares and engagement
* Paid\-ad performance
* Number of new formats tested
* Frequency of breakout creatives



 We'd rather test
 **10 genuinely interesting ideas** 
 than spend a week polishing one safe video.
 


 You'll Probably Love This Role If
 * After Effects feels like home
* You obsess over interesting transitions and typography
* You save ads and Reels because you're trying to reverse\-engineer how they were made
* You can edit extremely quickly
* You have opinions about what happens in the first 2 seconds of a Reel
* You enjoy combining design, editing, memes, pop culture and AI
* You experiment with new AI tools before someone asks you to
* You want your creative work to have a measurable impact on the growth of a startup


 Work Setup
 
 This is a
 **full\-time Work From Office role in Bangalore.** 




**And yes — you get a Mac mini to work on.** 




**You'll have significant creative freedom, a high volume of ideas and assets to play with, and extremely fast feedback on whether your work is actually performing.** 



 Compensation
 
**₹4–6 LPA** 
 , depending on experience, portfolio, creative ability and speed.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Please share:
 


1. Your CV
2. Your motion graphics / video editing portfolio
3. **5 short\-form videos or motion pieces you're most proud of**
4. **Any AI\-generated creative experiments you've made**



**A strong portfolio matters significantly more to us than your degree.** 



* **Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**

title: Product Engineer(2 to 5 Yrs)
description:
Framsikt Technologies is looking for a Product Engineer to join our high\-performing R\&D center in Bangalore. This isn’t a standard development role—this is for an engineer who wants to build great products, work closely with Product and Design, and grow into an independent, end\-to\-end product engineer in an AI\-native engineering environment.
 



  





  





**The Mission:** 




  





 Framsikt is a critical pillar of the Visma Group, one of Europe's leading software companies. Our mission is direct and high\-stakes: we power the technology behind Norway’s public sector management. Our platform is the central nervous system for strategic planning and financial workflows for over 300 municipalities, enabling data\-driven decisions that impact the lives of 5\.4 million citizens.
 



  





 When you build here, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.
   





  





**The Role: Autonomy \& AI\-First Development** 




  





 We are moving past the era of "manual" coding.
 



  





 At Framsikt, we expect engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build software. As a Developing Product Engineer, you will build production features while learning to use AI coding tools, agentic workflows, and context engineering to make your development faster and more effective.
 



  





 You will work with experienced engineers to solve problems, make sound technical decisions, and gradually take greater ownership of features from discovery through production.
 



  




* Build AI\-first: Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Build for scale: Apply common engineering patterns across architecture, APIs, data, security, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Engineer the context: Write structured prompts, provide the right codebase context and constraints, and learn how to guide AI tools towards reliable outcomes.
* Own quality: Write unit tests, contribute to CI/CD, participate in code reviews, and use observability tools to understand and improve production systems.
* Shape the product: Partner closely with Product and Design, bring technical thinking into discovery, and turn prototypes into production with speed and clarity.



  





**The Engineering Culture: Deep Focus over Shallow Output** 




  





 We despise "the feature factory." Our Bangalore R\&D center is a high\-trust, low\-overhead environment designed for engineers who love their craft. We prioritize deep work and systems thinking. You will find a flat hierarchy where the best idea wins, regardless of tenure.
 



  





 We actively encourage "breaking things" in the pursuit of better LLM orchestration and agentic design paradigms. If you are the type of engineer who spends their weekends experimenting with new model evaluations or building custom CLI tools to automate your own job, you will be among peers here.
 



  

  





**What You’ll Bring?** 




  





**Eligibility** 




  




* Education : Any professional technical graduation or masters
* 2\+ years of engineering excellence, ideally with C\#, SQL, Angular, and TypeScript (Azure is a plus)
* We are technology\-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals above specific technology experience, as long as you are open to working with the Microsoft technology stack mentioned above.
* Good at problem solving, curious soul and ability to learn quickly and agile



  





**You are a perfect fit if you:** 




  




* Have a good foundation in software engineering, APIs, data modeling, testing, and application architecture.
* Can independently deliver well\-defined features and seek guidance when solving complex or unfamiliar problems.
* See AI coding agents as a force multiplier and are willing to make them part of your everyday engineering workflow.
* Enjoy experimenting with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf.
* Can write structured prompts and provide the context and constraints needed to get useful results from AI tools.Care about code quality, reliability, maintainability, and good engineering practices even when moving fast.
* Enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn ideas and prototypes into production.
* Are comfortable receiving feedback, learning from experienced engineers, and taking increasing ownership of your work.



  





**Our Culture : Built on the following core three values:** 




  




* Reliable – We deliver with ownership, quality and integrity.
* Helpful – We succeed by supporting each other and our customers.
* Engaged – We stay curious, take initiative and continuously improve.

title: Creative Designer
description:
A Creative Designer at Indee is a multi\-faceted role shaping the visual \& brand language across marketing collaterals, brand assets, decks, and social media that the company and our clients rely on. You'll work closely with the Head of Design, Marketing Manager and other stakeholders to ensure every visual touchpoint reflects the company’s identity and vision.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design and produce visually compelling collaterals such as marketing decks, business reports, investor presentations, and product documents.
* Produce digital content such as social media creatives, assets for clients, email graphics, and landing pages.
* Contribute to brand identity, including logo design, typography, and iconography.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, gather context, align on deliverables, and ship with precision.
* Manage multiple tasks in parallel and deliver in fast\-paced environments while maintaining high standards.



  





**Qualification** 




 Education: Graduate
 



 Experience: 2\+ years of hands\-on experience as a visual/graphic/creative designer, ideally from a high\-growth company or marketing agency.
 



  





**Must\-haves** 



* Demonstrated ability to design to company standards and across different brand identities, not just your own aesthetic.
* Proficiency in traditional tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop), and Google Suite (Slides, Docs).
* Use of modern AI tools such as Claude Design or Figma Make in your design process for rapid ideation and speeding up repetitive tasks.
* Strong portfolio showcasing deck design, social media, print design, and brand identity.
* Highly skilled at visual balance of designs via layouting, typography, and usage of color.
* Clear articulation of design decisions and ability to take feedback constructively.
* A deep sense of ownership from brief to final asset.



  





**Good\-to\-haves** 



* Experience designing for entertainment, media, or SaaS/B2B products.
* Data\-visualization and infographic design.

****About The Company:****
 Cradlewise is a San\-Francisco, Bangalore and Pune based sleep tech company. We build innovative solutions for parents. Our products are designed to take the stress out of parenthood.
   

  

 Our first product \- the award winning Cradlewise smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts to bounce along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep—just like a parent! → See how our smart crib works
   

  

 We are working to reimagine the baby nursery to make it smart, intuitive and delightful. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values, and our culture!
   

  

****About The Cradlewise Design Team****
 Cradlewise Design is a close\-knit team of User\-Experience Designers, Visual Designers and Video editors from all over India. We create experiences to help every family sleep and live better, through science\-driven solutions, and it's the role of the team to humanize and create every touchpoint with empathy and support.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Cradlewise solved sleep for babies. Now we're going after what comes next: a brand\-new software product in the kids category, starting from a blank page. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the design from zero to one: the research, the flows, the visual language, the first shipped version. You'll sit in on parent interviews happening right now, sketch the same week, and watch your work decide what we build. You'll also shape the Cradlewise app and web portal that thousands of families already use daily.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Design a 0\-to\-1 product in the kids category: from discovery and user research through flows, prototypes, and the first release.
* Create a visual language that works for two audiences at once: kids and their parents.
* Design and improve the Cradlewise app and web portal, including our subscriptions experience, funnels, and retention experiments.
* Prototype fast, test with real families, and iterate. Speed matters more than polish at this stage.
* Contribute to our design system for consistency across products.
* Work directly with founders, product, tech, content, and marketing to take designs live.
* Keep designs accessible and grounded in human\-factors principles.


****What You’ll Bring To The Role:****
* 3–5 years of experience in product/UI/UX design.
* A portfolio that can demonstrate your ability to work on modern digital interfaces.
* Craft beautiful experiences that visually present the user interface so information is easy to read, understand and find.
* Thorough understanding of the design process to perform research, build workflows and user journeys, execute design with high quality prototypes and test mock\-ups for feedback.
* Understanding and implementation of best practices including accessibility standards and human factors.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm, willingness to iterate quickly and strong bias for action.
* Passion for design and simplifying complex problems, and a hunger to experiment with new and innovative solutions.
* A humble team player who is a great partner to work with for cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to learn from your mistakes and absorb feedback.
* Great communication skills, product thinking (why’s) and comfort with presenting and discussing designs.
* High proficiency in design tools like Figma and AI tooling to intelligently design creative experiences.
* Ability to learn and use analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and make informed design decisions.


****Academic Qualifications****
* Bachelors or MA/MS degree (or higher) in Design (interaction, graphic or visual communication) or equivalent practical experience.


****What We Offer:****
* A founding\-designer seat on a 0\-to\-1 product: blank canvas, full ownership.
* Direct access to founders and daily collaboration with product and engineering.
* Autonomy to ideate, experiment, and execute, with regular reviews to accelerate your growth.
* A close\-knit, learning\-oriented design team and a hybrid working setup.
* Competitive salary.

About the Role:
 



  





 You have spent 3–6 years designing products that real users love, consumer apps,
 



 SaaS platforms, or both, and you know what it takes to get from a fuzzy problem to a
 



 polished, shipped experience.
 



 You will own design end\-to\-end across our mobile and web products, establish and
 



 evolve our design system, and set the bar for quality across the team. As we grow,
 



 you will have the opportunity to mentor junior designers and help build the design
 



 function from the ground up.
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



  





 • Own end\-to\-end design for mobile (iOS \& Android) and web, from
 



 discovery and wireframes to final UI and handoff.
 



 • Translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant
 



 experiences.
 



 • Run user research, usability testing, and competitor analysis to inform
 



 design decisions.
 



 • Balance user needs with business constraints and technical feasibility.
 



 • Build, maintain, and evolve a scalable design system and component
 



 library across web and mobile.
 



 • Define design principles, patterns, and guidelines for consistent product
 



 experiences.
 



 • Partner with product, engineering, and stakeholders to align on goals and
 



 priorities.
 



 • Present design decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical
 



 audiences.
 



 • Mentor junior and mid\-level designers and help define design processes
 



 as the team scales.

 consumer\-grade usability to complex dashboards and multi\-user
 



 workflows.

 design tokens.

 • Solid grasp of responsive web design and accessibility standards.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 We absorb that complexity so our customers never have to think about it. Which means it lands in our product instead. Our users should never have to feel it.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Design Engineer to help make Dodo Payments one of the best\-crafted products in fintech. You might be a designer who learned to code because handing off Figma was not enough, or an engineer who kept opening Figma because the interface was not good enough. Either way you care deeply about both.
   

  

 You will sit directly between design and engineering, across dashboard, checkout, billing, onboarding, analytics, and new products. You will explore ideas visually, prototype them quickly, and often build the final thing yourself. Sometimes the fastest way to answer a design question is Figma. Sometimes it is 100 lines of code.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and Build: Turn complicated payment concepts into surprisingly simple interfaces, and ship the production UI in React yourself.
* Prototyping: Explore and validate interactions quickly, before we commit engineering time to them.
* Interface Craft: Obsess over typography, hierarchy, density, motion, and state. Use motion and interaction where they genuinely improve understanding, and not where they do not.
* 0 to 1 Product: Design and build new product experiences from scratch, starting from ambiguous problems.
* Systems and Primitives: Create the components and patterns that make the rest of Dodo better, without disappearing into a design system that never ships product.
* Raising the Bar: Improve existing experiences instead of accepting "it works," and push back when something is not good enough.
* Collaboration: Work directly with engineers, product, and founders on product decisions.


 You will have a lot of room to define Dodo's visual and interaction language. We expect you to use it.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, in a role that spanned both.
* Figma: Excellent with Figma as a thinking and prototyping tool, not just a handoff surface.
* Code: Comfortable writing React and TypeScript, and shipping your own work to production.
* Visual Taste: Strong visual judgment, and the ability to explain why something works.
* Interaction and Motion: Care for how interfaces move and respond. Framer Motion, Rive, GSAP, Three.js or similar is useful, but a particular library is not the point. Being able to make the thing in your head real is.
* Speed: You prototype extremely quickly and are comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem.
* Judgment: You know when simplicity takes more work, not less.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, and own how Dodo looks and feels. "Fintech has to look boring" is not an acceptable design constraint here.
* Ownership: You are not decorating finished requirements or producing mockups for someone else to interpret. You design it, you build it, you ship it.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.

title: UX Designer - C3 - CXP
description:
Bengaluru
   

  

 Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company \- a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of:**
* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 As a
 **UX Designer** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **5\-8 YEARS** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


****Role Responsibilities****
 We are looking for a
 **UX Designer with 5–8 years of experience** 
 who can take ownership of the UX process and do the
 **UX heavy lifting** 
 — from understanding customer needs and business objectives to defining problems, shaping experiences, and delivering thoughtful, user\-centric solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not just someone who creates screens. You should be able to
 **understand customers, speak their language, challenge assumptions, simplify complex problems, and translate insights into meaningful experiences.**
****What You’ll Do****
* Lead UX activities across projects, from discovery and problem definition through to final experience design.
* Understand customer needs, behaviours, pain points, motivations, and expectations.
* Conduct and support user research, interviews, workshops, journey mapping, personas, and usability testing.
* Translate customer and business requirements into clear UX strategies and solutions.
* Define information architecture, user flows, journeys, wireframes, and interaction models.
* Create prototypes and validate concepts with users and stakeholders.
* Identify usability issues and continuously improve the experience based on evidence and feedback.
* Work closely with UI designers and development teams to ensure UX intent is carried through to the final product.
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and clients to align user needs with business goals.
* Present and articulate design decisions clearly, using customer and business outcomes rather than design jargon.
* Challenge existing assumptions and propose better, simpler, and more effective solutions.
* Contribute to design systems, UX standards, and reusable patterns where appropriate.


****What We’re Looking For****
**Must Have**
* 5–8 years of professional UX design experience.
* Strong understanding of human\-centred design and UX methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive UX work and take ownership of complex problems.
* Strong ability to understand customer needs and speak the customer's language.
* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into clear UX problems and actionable solutions.
* Strong skills in:
* User journeys
* Information architecture
* User flows
* Wireframing
* Prototyping
* Usability testing
* UX research
* Interaction design
* Strong communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to explain why a design solution is right, not just what was designed.
* Experience working directly with clients, stakeholders, product teams, and developers.
* Strong proficiency in Figma or equivalent UX/design tools.


**The Person We’re Looking For**
 We value
 **problem\-solvers over screen\-makers** 
 .
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who:**
* Starts with the customer problem, not the UI.
* Is comfortable asking “Why?” and challenging the brief when needed.
* Can turn complex business requirements into simple customer experiences.
* Can work with incomplete information and bring structure to ambiguity.
* Is confident conducting conversations with customers and stakeholders.
* Can advocate for users while understanding business realities.
* Uses research, data, and evidence to support design decisions.
* Is comfortable owning the UX process from discovery → definition → design → validation.
* Can balance user needs, business objectives, technology constraints, and feasibility.
* Has strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger experience.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working on large\-scale digital products or enterprise platforms.
* Experience across web, mobile, or native applications.
* Experience in design systems and component\-based design.
* Experience facilitating design thinking workshops or discovery sessions.
* Exposure to accessibility and WCAG principles.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate UX research, ideation, prototyping, or analysis.


****What Success Looks Like****
 Within this role, you will be expected to:
   

  

**Understand → Define → Solve → Validate**
 You should be able to take a customer or business problem, understand it deeply, define the right UX problem, develop meaningful solutions, validate them, and clearly communicate the rationale behind your decisions.
   

  

**Core Attribute**
**We are looking for a UX designer who can do the UX heavy lifting — someone who understands customers deeply, speaks their language, owns the problem, and can turn complexity into simple, meaningful experiences.**
**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

****The Benefits****
 This is a
 **Fulltime** 
 position based in
 **Bangalore** 
 .
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer:**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
   

  

**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
   

  

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in
 **@valtech.com** 
 .
   

  

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
   

  

****About Valtech****
 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P\&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
   

  

 At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a
 **Lead Product Designer / UX Pod Lead** 
 to drive end\-to\-end design strategy and execution for core modules of our Cloud HR Tech platform.
 



 In this "Player\-Coach" role, you will be the design anchor for a dedicated product pod. You will manage a small, agile team of 2 to 4 UX/UI designers while remaining fully hands\-on with high\-impact feature design, design systems, and complex product workflows. You will partner directly with Pod Leads, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to build world\-class, enterprise\-grade SaaS experiences across web and mobile.
 



 If you are an experienced Senior/Lead Designer ready to own product strategy, mentor junior talent, and stay deeply connected to pixel\-perfect craft, this role is built for you. This position reports to the Senior Director of UX.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* **Core Workflow Ownership:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-priority HR tech modules (e.g., payroll engines, performance management, workforce analytics, mobile attendance).
* **High\-Fidelity Artifacts:** 
 Produce complete UX artifacts—from user journeys and wireframes to production\-ready Figma mockups, interactive prototypes, and micro\-interactions.
* **Design Systems:** 
 Drive the evolution of our centralized Figma Design System (tokens, auto\-layout, interactive components) and ensure component standardization across all pods.
* **AI\-First Workflows:** 
 Embed modern AI design tools (Figma AI, ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) into the team’s day\-to\-day workflow to maximize design velocity and research automation.
* **People Management:** 
 Manage, guide, and mentor a small team of 2–4 UX/UI designers. Conduct regular 1:1s, design critiques, and performance reviews.
* **Quality \& Governance:** 
 Set high standards for visual design, interaction quality, and design system usage across the team's output.
* **Sprint \& Capacity Planning:** 
 Allocate design resources within the pod, balance workload across sprint cycles, and ensure on\-time delivery of dev\-ready assets.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Establish efficient dev\-handoff workflows, usability testing cadence, and cross\-functional alignment habits with engineering and product.



**LOOKING FOR** 



* **8 to 10 years** 
 of total experience in UX/UI design for enterprise SaaS, B2B cloud applications, or consumer\-scale mobile apps.
* Proven experience (or demonstrated strong readiness) in leading design reviews, mentoring junior designers, or stepping into formal people management.
* Mastery of
 **Figma** 
 (Auto\-Layout, Variables, Component Architecture, Dev Mode, Design System Governance).
* Strong grounding in
 **Design Thinking, Information Architecture, and Product Strategy** 
 .
* Practical experience incorporating
 **AI tools** 
 into design research, copy, and UI generation workflows.
* Strong cross\-functional alignment skills—ability to push back on unrealistic tech constraints and advocate strongly for user experience with PMs and Dev Leads.
* Excellent verbal, visual, and written communication skills.



 Share your
 **Resume** 
 along with a
 **Portfolio link** 
 demonstrating both hands\-on SaaS web/mobile design work and examples of leading/mentoring design projects.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are looking for a senior product designer who thinks in problems, not screens, and has rebuilt their workflow around AI to move faster than a traditional design process allows.
 



 Design here doesn't look like it did two years ago. Our designers prototype in code with AI, test ideas as working software instead of static mocks, and go from problem framing to a clickable prototype in hours, not weeks. Figma is still in the toolkit, but it's no longer where most of the thinking happens.
 



  





**How designers work here\-** 
 We've changed how design works here over the last couple of years. Instead of presenting static mocks, we build interactive HTML prototypes with AI and let stakeholders click through real flows, with real states and edge cases. Ideas get tested as working software early, which means we can explore several directions in the time it used to take to polish one. AI is part of every phase of our process: research, ideation, UX writing, prototyping, and design system work. We also invest in our own tooling and reusable workflows so the whole team keeps getting faster. But AI doesn't make the decisions. What ships still comes down to a designer's judgment about the user, the business, and the product.
 



  





**What Will You Do** 




  





 ● Own design problems from framing through shipping. You'll define the problem, explore directions, prototype, test, and work with engineering to get it live, without needing much oversight
 



 ● Work with Product and Engineering as a partner in shaping what gets built, including pushing back on requirements when the brief is solving the wrong problem
 



 ● Design for both sides of our platform, on web and mobile: the event experiences attendees see, and the data\-heavy tables, settings, and workflows organizers live in every day
 



 ● Build interactive prototypes with AI as part of your regular process, and help the team improve its tooling and workflows over time
 



 ● Contribute to our design system as you go, so the quality you add compounds instead of staying local to one feature
 



 ● Handle a few workstreams at once and decide your own priorities
 



 ● Give direct, useful critique, take it well, and explain your design decisions to people outside design
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 ● 5 to 7 years of product design experience, at least 2 of them on B2B products
 



 ● Strong product judgment. You understand the business goal behind a request, question briefs that solve the wrong problem, and make trade\-offs between user needs, business outcomes, and engineering effort
 



 ● Depth in complex UX: multi\-step workflows, data\-dense interfaces, edge cases, and error and empty states
 



 ● Real experience shipping on both web and mobile, and comfort moving between the two: iOS/Android patterns, responsive behavior, platform constraints
 



 ● Fluent with AI in your daily workflow. It's a tool, not the job, but we expect it to be your default for exploration, prototyping, and iteration, and you should be able to show us how. Prototyping in code (HTML/CSS/React) is a plus
 



 ● High craft and speed together: a track record of moving fast in ambiguous environments without the work looking rushed
 



 ● A portfolio of recent, real work, ideally live products or interactive prototypes, with the thinking behind it, not just the output
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 ● Competitive compensation
 



 ● Employee\-friendly ESOPs
 



 ● Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
 



 ● Flexible leave program
 



 ● Home workstation setup allowance
 



 ● A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity

title: Director of Product Design, Partnerships
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead and elevate design for Ethos’s Partnerships business and Platform teams.Buying life insurance is one of the most important financial decisions a family can make. The vast majority of families complete this purchase with the facilitation of an agent. For the last hundred years this process was dominated by paper\-heavy, multi\-week purchase flows that made selling and buying life insurance a pain. Today, Ethos is giving them modern digital tooling to transform that. Ethos’s Partnerships Business is our B2B2C channel that gives independent insurance agents and insurance agencies a digital\-first platform, automated underwriting infrastructure, and multiple insurance offerings that help them serve their clients faster and grow their business.
   

  

 As the head of design for Ethos’ Partnership and Platforms you will have a direct opportunity to shape how design helps agents and their customers achieve their goals. This is a role with broad surface area and ideal for someone with the interest and versatility to work across a wide range of domains including agent onboarding and activation, quoting, applications, and sales, agent growth and retention, compensation, enterprise/agency management, partner integrations, insurance product expansion, underwriting, payments and more — all of which have direct or indirect impact on the end\-customer experience.
   

  

 This role combines an eye for craft, strategic vision, team management, with hands\-on design and product building excellence. You’ll champion intentional, intuitive, and strategic product experiences, compelling storytelling, and measurable business impact — and will help make Ethos the most trusted and user\-friendly life insurance experience in the world for agents and their clients.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead design for Partnerships and Platform — covering agent onboarding and activation, quoting, applications, and sales, agent growth and retention, compensation, enterprise/agency management, partner integrations, insurance product expansion, underwriting, payments experiments, and more.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a small but mighty team of product designers.
* Work closely with Research to discover and prioritize meaningful opportunities that improve business outcomes and agent success — collaborating with Product and Leadership to shape roadmaps.
* Work crossfunctionally with Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Performance Creative and Brand to shape compelling and connected end\-to\-end journeys for agents and agencies and their clients across segments, needs and products.
* Contribute to create an environment of excellence and growth where team members can do their best work and grow professionally and personally.
* Serve as Design Site Leader for Ethos India — Raise the bar for the design practice globally.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product design (UX) experience, including several years leading multi\-person design teams.
* 2\+ years of start\-up experience requiring fast decision making and ability to evaluate ambiguous product problems with a mix of intuition, user experience, and measurement.
* Experience working on B2B2C, gig economy, and products serving a range of company sizes.
* Proven ability to design for complex, decision\-heavy user journeys in industries like fintech, healthtech, or insuretech.
* Strong understanding of conversion optimization, user motivation, and behavior design principles.
* Proven ability to build and lead high performing teams.
* A portfolio showcasing strong visual, interaction design, and storytelling craft alongside compelling impact delivered for past businesses and their customers.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.

title: Head of Design
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**The role**
 HackerRank is hiring a Head of Design to define and own the experience for our platform and lead the organization responsible for delivering it. You will guide both traditional product experiences and emerging AI\-native and agentic experiences, through a team of product designers and design managers.
   

  

 As a member of Product, Engineering, and Design Leadership, you will serve as a strategic leader in the company. This role requires executive range and practitioner instincts. You should be able to move from an organizational question to a product strategy discussion, then into a working prototype or detailed interaction review without losing the thread between them. All of our leaders are builders.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Set experience strategy. Define the design vision for HackerRank’s platform and turn company strategy into a clear experience direction. Connect near\-term product decisions to a coherent view of where technical hiring and developer skills are going. Keep the organization close to customers and developers, using research, product data, prototypes, and direct observation to shape the work.
* Drive AI and agentic fluency. Shape how people interact with AI across the platform, from embedded intelligence to autonomous agents. Establish rigor around AI experience evals, agentic specifications, and emerging interaction practices. Set the expectation that designers experiment with models, agents, and code\-adjacent tools—and model that behavior yourself.
* Be the quality bar. Raise the quality and coherence of HackerRank’s end\-to\-end experience. Guide the information architecture, workflows, interaction patterns, and systems that make the platform feel like one product. Have a clear point of view on what good looks like, make that standard practical, and raise the quality of everything HackerRank ships.Drive strategic partnership. Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership. Shape product strategy, investment priorities, and roadmaps; clarify the problems worth solving; and make the trade\-offs required to balance customer value, technical reality, speed, and long\-term platform quality.Build and lead the team. Lead an organization that includes product designers and design managers. Hire and develop strong leaders, establish clear ownership, raise the quality of critique and decision\-making, and create an environment where designers can move quickly without lowering the bar.


**How You Will Lead**
 We expect you to get close to the work. You see yourself as a maker who can lead others through ambiguity, and you proactively spend time building with models and agents and shipping your work.
   

  

 You do not need to be a production engineer. You do need enough technical curiosity and fluency to prototype alongside engineers, explore ideas with modern AI and coding tools, and understand how model behavior, architecture, latency, cost, data, and evaluation shape the experience.
   

  

 You should be comfortable developing your own perspective on the product and market. You can communicate that perspective clearly to non\-designers and build support for improvements across the experience, from broad product strategy to the smallest interaction details.
   

  

 You have led senior designers and design managers, and you know how to raise the quality of the work without slowing the team down. Build early. Put ideas in front of customers. Learn from real behavior. Refine from evidence.
   

  

**Requirements And Experience We Are Looking For**
* A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong judgment, leadership, and high\-quality execution. Show us what shipped, what changed, and the role you played.
* Significant product design experience, including ownership of complex products or platforms and several years leading designers and design managers.
* A track record of building and developing strong design organizations, including hiring senior talent, coaching managers, clarifying ownership, and improving the overall caliber of the team.
* Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and turn ambiguous opportunities into shipped products.
* Direct experience delivering AI\-powered products, agentic experiences, or other non\-deterministic systems.
* A hands\-on approach. You enjoy getting into the work, making ideas tangible, and helping teams ship stronger results.
* Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools, including demonstrated use of AI, code\-adjacent tools, or working software to explore and communicate ideas. Framer experience is a plus.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank

* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.
* We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

title: Design Lead - Brand & Visual Design
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e\-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.
 



  





 Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M\+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000\+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India \- and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry\-free.
 



  





 Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 We’re looking for a Design Lead — Brand \& Visual Design to bring Snapmint’s brand to life across every consumer touchpoint and ensure a consistent, distinctive and high\-quality visual identity everywhere the brand shows up.
 



  





 • Role Title: Design Lead – Brand \& Visual Design
 



 • Department: Marketing
 



 • Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 • Experience: 8\-10Yrs
 



 • Location: Bangalore
 



 • Working Model: Work from Office – 5 Days per Week
 



 • Entity: Snapmint Credit Advisory Private Limited
 



  





**What You Own:** 




 • Own and conceptualize visual design across Snapmint — including the app, social media, digital
 



 campaigns, performance marketing, brand campaigns, marketing communication and offline brand touchpoints.
 



 • Conceptualize and execute visual ideas that make Snapmint distinctive, contemporary and
 



 culturally relevant.
 



 • Translate Snapmint’s existing brand identity and guidelines into compelling design across formats and platforms.
 



 • Lead the visual design for major brand campaigns, product launches and integrated marketing
 



 initiatives.
 



 • Ensure consistency and a high bar for visual quality across all consumer\-facing brand communication.
 



 • Work closely with Brand, Marketing, Content, Product and other teams to turn briefs and
 



 communication ideas into strong visual work.
 



 • Take ownership of design projects end\-to\-end, from conceptualization to final execution.
 



 • Build scalable design assets, templates and frameworks that help teams create faster while maintaining brand consistency.
 



 • Collaborate with agencies, freelancers and creative partners and ensure the quality of their design output.
 



 • Mentor designers and contribute to raising the overall design craft and creative standards of the team.
 



 • Stay deeply plugged into design, culture, technology and emerging visual trends.
 



 • Experiment with AI\-enabled design and creative tools to make the creative process faster, sharper and more experimental.
 



  





**What You Bring:** 




 • 8–10 years of experience in brand design, visual design or creative design.
 



 • Strong experience in a B2C technology, consumer internet, fintech, commerce or lifestyle company.
 



 • Graduate from NID or NIFT.
 



 • An exceptionally strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding visual craft, conceptual thinking and execution across multiple formats.
 



 • Experience working across both digital and offline brand touchpoints.
 



 • Strong understanding of visual communication, art direction, typography, composition, imagery,
 



 illustration, motion and digital design.
 



 • Ability to take a communication brief and turn it into a strong visual idea, not just execute an existing direction.
 



 • Strong understanding of how to express a brand consistently across different platforms and formats.
 



 • A deep passion for design, culture and creating work that people remember. Portfolio is mandatory.
 



  





**Why Snapmint:** 




 • Be Part of a 10X–100X Journey \- Help build and scale and be part of a high\-growth story.
 



 • Raise the Bar \- Learn from people who raise the bar.
 



 • Solve Hard Problems \- Work on meaningful, high\-impact challenges.
 



 • Own the Outcome \- Take ownership and make things happen.
 



 • Move Fast, Build Fast \- Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.
 



 • Make Real Impact \- See your work reach millions of customers.
 



 • Grow with Snapmint \- Take on bigger challenges as we scale.
